$comment: Deliberate coverage exclusions for `bun run e2e --strict`. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can check. A stale entry (the item is covered anyway) or a dead entry (the server no longer exposes it) fails the strict run. `flows` pins scenario names that must exist and pass. `stateSurfaces` declare the values an engine column can hold (statuses, step types, executors); each is read from the SUT database after the run and every declared value must be observed unless excluded, and every observed value must be declared. Every scenario must belong to a flow. `engines` roll named route groups, tools, node types and state surfaces into one figure per engine; strict requires 100% for each engine.

stateSurfaces.name: task-statuses
stateSurfaces.query: SELECT DISTINCT status AS value FROM agent_tasks

excluded.reason: transient: a draft is promoted to pending or unassigned when its attachment batch settles, before the suite reads the table
transient: an offered task is reviewing only between claim-for-review and accept or decline inside one poll
transient: set by crash recovery for the duration of one resume dispatch, which the heartbeat sweep (disabled here) drives
transient once a lead exists: a pool task is assigned to the lead at creation, and mcp-surface asserts the unassigned listing before claiming it

stateSurfaces.name: workflow-run-statuses
stateSurfaces.query: SELECT DISTINCT status AS value FROM workflow_runs

excluded.reason: transient: every run the suite starts reaches a terminal or waiting state before the table is read

stateSurfaces.name: workflow-step-statuses
stateSurfaces.query: SELECT DISTINCT status AS value FROM workflow_run_steps

excluded.reason: transient: instant executors finish inside the request; async ones move to waiting
no engine path writes a skipped step: only a cooldown-skipped run carries skipped (src/workflows/engine.ts), and foreach-join reads the step value defensively

stateSurfaces.name: script-run-statuses
stateSurfaces.query: SELECT DISTINCT status AS value FROM script_runs

excluded.reason: transient: every durable run the suite launches is settled or cancelled before the table is read

stateSurfaces.name: script-run-step-types
stateSurfaces.query: SELECT DISTINCT stepType AS value FROM script_run_journal

stateSurfaces.name: script-run-step-statuses
stateSurfaces.query: SELECT DISTINCT status AS value FROM script_run_journal

stateSurfaces.name: script-scopes
stateSurfaces.query: SELECT DISTINCT scope AS value FROM scripts

stateSurfaces.name: script-fs-modes
stateSurfaces.query: SELECT DISTINCT fsMode AS value FROM scripts

excluded.reason: v1 answers 501 before a script is stored, so no row can carry it

stateSurfaces.name: script-executors
stateSurfaces.query: SELECT DISTINCT executor AS value FROM scripts WHERE executor IS NOT NULL
